original_context_note: Candidate 17 was compared with material-001.md:31–80 and target-selection.json/full_target, whose entire string is retained verbatim in spec.full_target (also read back at /spec/full_target). H001 is exactly T>0,0<gamma<=1,R>0 and H002 exactly the real mean-zero H^gamma radius-R datum; their original origins are retained, and neither is unused. P/spec.conclusion gives the complete uniform-in-ball statement, all positive integer grids and n=0,...,L, original distributional smooth-approximation solution class and unfiltered update. D001–D011 preserve normalized measure, Fourier convention, S signs, zero-mode inverses and all original F_tau,H_tau coefficients. Parametric iterates are explicitly initialized by the datum under discussion. D014 is only a polynomial construction until R004 proves extension; D021 is guarded by H001. D022–D030 preserve the supplied stage/interpolation/residual formulas, without granting endpoint continuity or estimates as definitions. The 12 unique-producer units follow the original logical phases: exact flow; covariance/majorants; dyadic sum; mixed remainder; continuous source estimates; elementary normal form; interpolation; stage defects; residual; coupled low/high stability with forcing; restarted bootstrap; fixed-step density. All edges are actual AND inputs, roots are only the two original H and four explicit E, and N001–N011 are proved, with no cycle or hidden numerical regularity assumption. R010 keeps the coupled endpoint/forcing calculation in one context with four explicit paragraphs. Primary verification: E001 is the read 42-page Babin–Ilyin–Titi arXiv:0910.1389v2 (23 October 2010), with Sections 3–6 and Theorems 4.2–4.3,5.1,6.3–6.5; its normalized homogeneous norms and opposite source sign are handled explicitly in R001. E002–E004 use the read exact 50-page Li–Wu FoCM-3.pdf manuscript cited by the supplied paper: definitions, Proposition 3.4, Lemma 7.2, product bounds, Eq.(1.4) and the full algebraic identity context were checked. Its spatial norms differ by sqrt(2pi), accounted for in R005. The stray printed ds in (4.17) is resolved by the clean repeated formula (6.1), disclosed in E004.context. Hash-bound access/PDF/text evidence is registered in every E. Ordered retrieval failures were preserved; the cited original primary PDFs were ultimately accessible, so no UNVERIFIED_PRIMARY assumption is needed. No source convergence theorem is used. Independent numerical experiments in material-001.md:476–583 are omitted because they neither prove nor enter Theorem 1; every needed mathematical calculation through density at 471–474 is represented. All own packets have been actually read, with unchanged mathematical views retained across later edits by the tool. These are same-author checks under yui-nl0-audit-a-2, not independent Audit A judgments; structural validity alone was not treated as proof.
